title_i18n.es: La IA ya puede robar criptomonedas.

excerpt_i18n.en: Recent research indicates AI technology could be used to steal cryptocurrency, raising new concerns about digital asset security, though existing protections remain effective.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 近期研究显示，人工智能技术可能被用于窃取加密货币，引发对数字资产安全的新担忧。专家指出，AI能够分析交易模式并识别漏洞，但现有安全措施仍能提供有效防护。

items.title: Amazon Has New Frontier AI Models—and a Way for Customers to Build Their Own
items.raw_excerpt: Nova Forge lets Amazon’s customers train frontier models for different tasks—a potential breakthrough in making AI actually useful for businesses.

title_i18n.en: Amazon Has New Frontier AI Models—and a Way for Customers to Build Their Own
title_i18n.zh: 亚马逊推出全新前沿AI模型，并推出客户自建模型方案。
title_i18n.es: Amazon presenta nuevos modelos de IA Frontier, y una forma para que los clientes construyan los suyos propios.

excerpt_i18n.en: Nova Forge lets Amazon’s customers train frontier models for different tasks—a potential breakthrough in making AI actually useful for businesses.
excerpt_i18n.zh: Nova Forge使亚马逊客户能够针对不同任务训练前沿模型，这有望成为推动AI真正为企业所用的突破性进展。
excerpt_i18n.es: Nova Forge permite a los clientes de Amazon entrenar modelos de vanguardia para distintas tareas, un avance potencial para que la inteligencia artificial resulte realmente útil para las empresas.

items.title: AWS CEO Matt Garman Wants to Reassert Amazon’s Cloud Dominance in the AI Era
items.raw_excerpt: As Google and Microsoft continue to surge, the AWS chief lays out his pitch: cheaper, reliable AI delivered at hyperscale.

title_i18n.en: AWS CEO Matt Garman Wants to Reassert Amazon’s Cloud Dominance in the AI Era
title_i18n.zh: AWS首席执行官马特·加尔曼希望在人工智能时代重振亚马逊云业务的领导地位。
title_i18n.es: El CEO de AWS, Matt Garman, quiere reafirmar el dominio de Amazon en la nube durante la era de la IA.

excerpt_i18n.en: As Google and Microsoft continue to surge, the AWS chief lays out his pitch: cheaper, reliable AI delivered at hyperscale.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 随着谷歌和微软持续发力，亚马逊云服务负责人亮出他的策略：以超大规模提供更廉价、可靠的AI服务。
excerpt_i18n.es: Mientras Google y Microsoft continúan su ascenso, el director de AWS presenta su propuesta: inteligencia artificial más barata y fiable entregada a hiperescala.
